layouts.description: Draft configuration: The identified airfield perimeter follows the western rectangular taxiway, northern eastbound return, broad northeastern turn and southeast-to-southwest perimeter. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4772.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
